nodes.name: Trigger (replace with client's app)
nodes.notes: Replace this with the client's real trigger: 'New booking' (Calendly/Acuity), 'Order paid' (Stripe/Square/Shopify), 'Job completed' (Jobber), 'Deal won' (a CRM), etc. Or a Schedule node + their API.

nodes.name: POST to BAAM Review
nodes.notes: Map the {{ $json.* }} placeholders to the trigger's real fields. Set the Header Auth credential to this location's BAAM key (Authorization: Bearer brk_...). 201 = queued, 200 = skipped (dup/opt-out), 401 = bad key.

meta.templateDescription: One client = one copy. Replace the trigger with the client's app, set the Header Auth credential to that location's BAAM Review API key, map the fields. See N8N_BRIDGE_RUNBOOK.md.
